object_description: three-bay volume with an incomplete stepped front
design_condition: The volume is located on the western edge, creating clearance toward the village and a north-south path, while its future extension completes the upstream span without altering the relationship with the neighboring houses.

positive.statement: The western-edge location has a quiet obviousness and creates significant clearance on the village side.
The north-south path extends the existing route and is connected to the school entrance.
The three-bay volume establishes a clear front toward the fields and a discontinuous front toward the village, producing a scale relationship close to individual housing.
The typological and structural concept is relevant and supports the proposed organization.
The urban-planning and landscape response is appreciated by the jury.

negative.statement: The waiting bay in the first stage weakens the volume through the imbalance it induces.
The playground layout remains schematic, pedestrian access from the village is unaddressed, and slope management is unresolved.
The entrance step conflicts with the overhang gesture and creates an obstacle between the covered courtyard and the hall.
The valuable conceptual choices are weakened because they are not reflected rigorously in the plans and facades.
The rotation of some classrooms contradicts the concept’s intended single orientation.
The services clutter the central hall and do not resolve the position of the classroom changing rooms.
